tickets.title: Collect address and residency update details
tickets.text: Use the address update form to capture the Willowdoodle‑Copperwisp household's new mailing address and residency information after their marriage. Include effective date of change and any accounts needing address updates.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-06 is to update the household profile and address records.

tickets.title: Prepare liquidity planning analysis
tickets.text: Review Mira and Arlen's cash needs, including the remaining lease expense and desired six‑month reserve, and recommend funding sources to meet the shortfall. Summarize any portfolio trades needed before the 2024‑03‑18 deadline.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-18 is to address the cash reserve and remaining lease impact.

tickets.title: Request estate document collection
tickets.text: Ask Mira Willowdoodle and Arlen Copperwisp to provide copies of their wills, powers of attorney, and any amendment pages so the advisory team can update the planning record.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-12 is to collect estate document copies and any amendment pages.

tickets.title: Provide taxable account registration options
tickets.text: Prepare a plain‑language comparison of keeping Mira's Velvet Acorn taxable account individually titled versus opening a new joint account for household savings, and deliver the options by 2024‑03‑01.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-01 is to provide the taxable account registration options.

tickets.title: Address online access for spouse and household view
tickets.text: Coordinate with the advisory portal team to enable Arlen Copperwisp view‑only access to the household dashboard while preserving Mira Willowdoodle's trading authority on her individual IRA and taxable accounts, to be completed by 2024‑02‑29.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-02-29 is to address online access for a spouse and household view.

tickets.title: Resolve beneficiary record inconsistencies
tickets.text: Identify and correct the mismatched beneficiary designations across Mira's IRA, Arlen's employer plan, and the Velvet Acorn Custody accounts, and report the resolution by 2024‑03‑08.
tickets.evidence: follow-up is needed by 2024-03-08 on beneficiary record inconsistencies.

tickets.title: Fix custodian beneficiary update error
tickets.text: Work with Velvet Acorn Custody to resolve the website error that prevented adding Arlen as a contingent beneficiary and obtain a confirmation number, to be completed by 2024‑02‑27.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-02-27 is to address the custodian beneficiary update error.

tickets.title: Review employer benefit elections
tickets.text: Analyze Mira's newlywed enrollment window and Arlen's benefit‑change process to determine optimal medical, life, and disability coverage selections for the combined household, and present recommendations by 2024‑03‑05.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-05 is to review employer benefit elections.

tickets.title: Align life and disability coverage
tickets.text: Compare the existing term life policies, group life coverages, and disability benefits for Mira and Arlen, reconcile beneficiary designations and replacement‑income assumptions, and deliver an alignment plan by 2024‑03‑14.
tickets.evidence: follow-up is needed by 2024-03-14 on life and disability coverage alignment.

tickets.title: Review mortgage and property records
tickets.text: Obtain the current mortgage statement, deed vesting page, and homeowner policy declarations for the Lakewood townhouse and assess any needed updates, to be completed by 2024‑03‑15.
tickets.evidence: Follow-up is needed by 2024-03-15 for the mortgage and property record review based on those missing property records.

tickets.title: Prepare joint tax withholding projection
tickets.text: Create a coordinated 2024 withholding and estimated‑tax projection for Mira Willowdoodle and Arlen Copperwisp, incorporating both salaries, bonuses, investment income, and Mira's $42,000 capital‑loss carryforward, to deliver by 2024‑04‑05.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-04-05 is to prepare the joint tax withholding projection.
